custom_expected:
1. Turning See Financial Data OFF does NOT silently uncheck the dependent settings. Instead the system shows a prompt telling the user they must turn off the settings that depend on See Financial Data.

2. The prompt lists the dependent settings that need to be disabled (whichever are currently ON): Invoicing and Payments (full CRUD), Part Sales (full CRUD), Order Parts (Work Orders sub-setting), and Manage AP/AR.

3. After the user confirms the prompt, the below given listed dependent settings are turned off/unchecked

- Part Sales -> View Create & Edit, Delete
- Invoicing & Payments -> View Create & Edit, Delete
 - Order Parts.

If the user cancels, See Financial Data stays ON and nothing changes.
custom_preconds:
1. Log in as a user who can create and edit custom roles, and open the role editor for a custom role.
2. The role has See Financial Data turned ON.
3. The role has Part sales View, Edit, and Delete all turned ON.
4. The role has Invoicing and Payments View, Edit, and Delete all turned ON.
custom_steps:
1. In the role editor, turn See Financial Data OFF (from the Cross-Cutting Toggles card).

2. Observe the confirmation prompt that appears -> Turning See Financial Data OFF prompts the user that Disabling See Financial Data will also disable Part Sales and Invoicing & Payments and Order Parts. Continue?

3. Read the list of dependent settings named in the prompt.

4. Confirm the prompt to disable the listed settings, then inspect the Part Sales and Invoicing and Payments row checkboxes.
title: Turning See Financial Data OFF prompts the user that Disabling See Financial Data will also disable Part Sales and Invoicing & Payments and Order Parts. Continue?
